connector.name: Infraveil Control Plane
connector.registryDescription: Govern your backend control plane from your AI agent - signed, human-approval-gated.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package infraveil-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the infraveilhq account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: INFRAVEIL_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Your Infraveil client id (same one the agent uses)

env.name: INFRAVEIL_AGENT_ID
env.description: The agent id this MCP server speaks for

env.name: INFRAVEIL_AGENT_TOKEN
env.description: The agent's existing token; used to sign requests. Never minted here.

env.name: INFRAVEIL_AGENT_FILE
env.description: Alternative to the four vars above: path to your rendered agent source; ids and token are read from it.

env.name: INFRAVEIL_VERIFY_RESPONSES
env.description: Verify the control plane's response signatures (default on). Set 0 only for debugging.
